# Tests that pass against a single-node server but FAIL against a cluster.
#
# The s3tests-cluster job honors ../known-failures.txt and gates on this file
# as well, so a test that fails on one node and passes on three is not listed
# here.
#
# This is a BUG LIST, not a scope statement. In ../known-failures.txt an entry
# means "not implemented / out of scope"; an entry here means behaviour that
# already works on storagefs and does not on the replicated data plane. Add one
# only with the root cause and the issue number, and take it out with the fix.
#
# The 19 entries this file was created with are gone: they were four bugs
# (#98 ranged GET, #99 conditional GET, #100 zero-byte Content-Length,
# #101 chunked PutObject), all fixed.

# --- Object versioning on clusterstore (12) -----------------------------------
#
# clusterstore records a bucket's versioning state but does not keep object
# versions: it implements the bucket half of fs.Versioner and neither
# GetObjectVersion nor ListObjectVersions. A versioned write on the cluster
# overwrites where it should create a version.
#
# Deferred rather than unknown: mapping versions onto clusterstore's retained
# generations is named in #123's own scope and is the part not in this pass.
# Reading degrades correctly meanwhile — a ?versions listing on the cluster
# reports each object as its own "null" version, which is what a
# never-versioned bucket is.
s3tests/functional/test_s3.py::test_multipart_copy_versioned
s3tests/functional/test_s3.py::test_multipart_put_current_object_if_none_match
s3tests/functional/test_s3.py::test_object_copy_versioned_bucket
s3tests/functional/test_s3.py::test_object_copy_versioned_url_encoding
s3tests/functional/test_s3.py::test_put_current_object_if_match
s3tests/functional/test_s3.py::test_put_current_object_if_none_match
s3tests/functional/test_s3.py::test_versioning_bucket_atomic_upload_return_version_id
s3tests/functional/test_s3.py::test_versioning_bucket_create_suspend
s3tests/functional/test_s3.py::test_versioning_copy_obj_version
s3tests/functional/test_s3.py::test_versioning_obj_list_marker
s3tests/functional/test_s3.py::test_versioning_obj_plain_null_version_overwrite_suspended
s3tests/functional/test_s3.py::test_versioning_obj_plain_null_version_removal

# --- Server-side encryption on clusterstore (8) ------------------------------
#
# clusterstore cannot encrypt on this branch, so it refuses rather than
# storing plaintext under a header claiming otherwise. The coordinator
# encrypting before it fragments — so parity, repair and peer transfer stay
# keyless — is #124's cluster half.
#
# Remove these once that lands and the node template carries a master key.
s3tests/functional/test_s3.py::test_sse_s3_default_upload_1b
